senses.gloss:
√gāh
present: [1.] gā́hate etc. V.+ gā́hati etc. 
perfect: jagāha jigāhīre 
[aorist: ajīgahat agāḍha agāhiṣṭa ]
future: [1.] gāhiṣyate E.+ -- [2.] gāḍhā gāhitā 
verbal: gāḍha S.+ gāhita E.+ gāhitum -gāhya S.+ 
secondary: passive: gāhyate etc. E.+ -- intensive: jáṅgahe jāgāh- -- desiderative: jigāhiṣa- jighākṣa- -- causative: gāhayati etc. 
derivatives: -gáha gáhana RV.E. gah- gaṅhmán B. gáhvara AV.+ gāhá V.+ -gāhin C. -gāhya E.+ gāhana S.+ gāhanīya C. gámbhan B. gambhára RV. gámbhiṣṭha B. gabhīrá V.+ gambhīrá V.+ gabhvara C. gādhá V.+ gādhana C. 
The connection of these derivatives is probable, but not beyond question.
